basics.name: Ahmed M. Sozzer
basics.label: Full Stack Engineer
basics.summary: I'm a full-stack engineer at FYCLabs, a studio that builds products for startups. I work directly with founders and the people using what we ship, find the step someone is still doing by hand, and build whatever removes it.

work.name: FYCLabs
work.summary: A studio that builds products for startups.

tracks.name: Insurance platform
tracks.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Node/Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, BullMQ, GCP
highlights: Proved the insurance carrier was silently dropping our policy photos, and ran the weekly call with the carrier

Built overnight BullMQ jobs that re-check every policy and resubmit whatever the carrier dropped. They caught about 10 broken policies out of roughly 300 that nobody had noticed, and odd cases now email the team with their logs
Traced slow PostgreSQL queries with `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` and fixed them with composite indexes and raw SQL

tracks.name: Education network single sign-on
highlights: Built one login across 3 new portals and 4 legacy ones, used by 50,000+ people a day. The SSO is its own Next.js app that checks each Firebase-signed token with Firebase, confirms the user can access that portal, and redirects them in
Talked the PM and senior engineers out of a repo per portal, since the portals share one theme, and built one monorepo on a single Amplify deployment where subdomains split each portal's routes
tracks.credit: SSO mine, portals with a team
tracks.creditWeb: the sign-on and the deployment were mine; the portals were built by a small team I was on

tracks.name: Women's health app
tracks.stack: React Native, TypeScript, Node/Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, GCP
highlights: Built the React Native app from zero to launch and still own it. The client came back for a second phase
Built the onboarding that places each user in one of 10 phenotypes and the community where doctors, users and an AI bot steered by the lead doctor answer posts, frontend and backend
On other client projects I wired GoHighLevel, Zoho and HubSpot into their backends over REST and webhooks, and set up CI/CD on GCP. I ship to production several times a week

work.name: Holiday Channel

Took the iOS app from Figma designs to App Store release

work.name: Luminii LLC
highlights: Replaced a manual pricing recalibration with an ML pricing model fed by live supplier data, then reindexed the 15,000-record database under it and added automated validation

skills.name: AI-assisted development
keywords: Claude Code daily, with a spec review before any code and hooks and CI gating each change

projects.name: AMS-X
projects.description: filament swaps for my print shop
highlights: I run a small 3D printing business, and any filament change past Bambu's own AMS needs a person at the printer. AMS-X moves that loop onto a server and the printer's external-spool mode

A FastAPI server and Next.js dashboard drive the printer over its undocumented local MQTT, confirmed on an A1 mini and a P1S. Each swap is planned from the sliced 3MF, and a person still feeds the spool until the motor modules work

projects.name: PlusWeb
projects.description: an Express-style HTTP framework in C++17
highlights: Wrote it because I couldn't understand Express by reading it. libuv, llhttp, a trie router and middleware, now in Microsoft's vcpkg. 4.8x Express at 5 routes and flat to 10,000, where Express slows 50x

projects.name: pdf-redactor
projects.description: a task written to Terminal-Bench 3's spec
highlights: Asks a coding agent to redact court filings so nothing under the box is recoverable and nothing else changes. Claude Code and Codex scored 0 on every run, and in all six real attempts a name drawn as vector outlines survived
